```yaml
name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: Path to agent markdown files
        required: false
        default: .continue/agents
        type: string
    secrets:
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:
        required: true

jobs:
  discover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.list.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install jq
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - id: list
        run: |
          AGENTS_PATH="${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          echo "Searching for .md agents in $AGENTS_PATH"
          FILES=$(find "$AGENTS_PATH" -type f -name "*.md")
          if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then
            echo "agents=[]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "$FILES" | jq -R . | jq -s . >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  run-agents:
    needs: discover
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJSON(needs.discover.outputs.agents) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install -g @continue/cli

      - name: Run agent
        id: run-agent
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          continue run "${{ matrix.agent }}" > agent_output.txt
          echo "output=$(cat agent_output.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Append to job summary
        run: |
          echo "## Agent ${{ matrix.agent }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "${{ steps.run-agent.outputs.output }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: Create check run
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          AGENT_NAME: ${{ matrix.agent }}
          AGENT_OUTPUT: ${{ steps.run-agent.outputs.output }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const owner = context.repo.owner;
            const repo = context.repo.repo;
            const headSha = context.payload.pull_request.head.sha;
            const agentName = process.env.AGENT_NAME;
            const output = process.env.AGENT_OUTPUT;
            const conclusion = '${{ steps.run-agent.outcome }}';
            await github.checks.create({
              owner,
              repo,
              name: `Continue Agent: ${agentName}`,
              head_sha: headSha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion,
              output: {
                title: `Continue Agent: ${agentName}`,
                summary: output
              }
            })
```
